title: Ethics at Sunshine Foods Ltd
body: Sunshine Foods Ltd makes packaged snacks. Two years ago its CEO announced in a meeting of all staff that the company would be known for honest dealing, and she has since led every ethics initiative herself. The company published a written document setting out its principles of conduct on product safety and quality, fair marketing, conflicts of interest and financial reporting. The HR department now checks the values of candidates while hiring, every training programme includes a session on corporate ethics, and an anonymous helpline lets employees report unethical behaviour. Small groups of employees from every level meet each month to discuss the company's ethics policies. However, in two years no audit has been carried out to check how far decisions and actions comply with the written principles, and the top management team has never sat with employees to discuss such results and decide on further action.
